title: Anesthesia equipment issue documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports documented procedure name, counts, specimen labeling, equipment problems, and key recovery or management concerns without generating a plan.
user_facing_items.population: Patients undergoing surgery or invasive procedures where the checklist is applied.
user_facing_items.setting: Operating room or procedural setting before anesthesia, before incision, and before leaving the room.
restrictions: Exact for checklist documentation of identity, site, procedure, consent, anesthesia equipment checks, pulse oximetry, allergy, airway or aspiration risk, blood loss, team communication, procedure record, counts, specimens, equipment issues, and recovery concerns. It does not replace local UAE policy.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact WHO Sign Out section supports recording anesthesia or surgical equipment problems before leaving the operating room; it does not diagnose the failure or direct corrective action.
